requestAnimationFrame and animation
timing

requestAnimationFrame schedules a callback before an upcoming repaint. Its timestamp can drive time-based
animation; cancelAnimationFrame cancels a pending callback.

Animation එක screen refresh එකට ගෙැළJපන්න requestAnimationFrame() භාවිත කරන්න. Frame count එක මත JනJවයි timestamp එJකන් elapsed time ගෙණනය කරන්න. Background tabs වල callbacks pause Jහහෝ slow Jවන්න පුළුවන්.
